checks.title: House bankroll
checks.text: The house’s stablecoins, in the treasury and the betting pools, are −2.2% over 30 days, at $3.13M. Watch below −5%, alert below −15%.

checks.title: House result trend
checks.text: DefiLlama switched from counting fees to the full betting result on 21 Jul 2026, so earlier periods aren’t comparable. Like-for-like 90-day comparisons start 17 Jan 2027. The 90 days to 19 Nov 2026 brought in $643K.

checks.title: Share bought back
checks.text: Buybacks took 32% of the $643K house result over the 90 days to 19 Nov 2026. Healthy from 30%, alert below 15%. Buybacks run at a steady ~$2.3K a day, so this share mostly moves with the house result.
